RPE is Rate of Perceived Exertion, a 1 to 10 scale for how hard a set felt. A 10 means you couldn't have done another rep, a 9 means one rep left in the tank, an 8 means two left, and so on.

It's useful because it adjusts to your day. The same weight can be an 8 when you're fresh and a 9 when you slept badly, and RPE lets you load the bar to match. For most working sets, aiming for 7 to 9 builds strength without grinding every rep to failure.

If you want, I can show you how it fits into what you're doing now.
